stories.h: Eisenkot and Golan's Democrats agree coalition deal
stories.s: After talks resumed, Yashar and the Democrats agreed terms giving Golan's party four portfolios, including an expanded national security ministry now held by Ben Gvir, plus a pledge to fully repeal the judicial overhaul.

stories.h: Netanyahu weighs offering Eisenkot rotation, serving second
stories.s: Sources told the Post that Netanyahu is considering announcing, possibly this weekend, that he would take the second turn as PM in a unity rotation with Eisenkot, framing it as a security necessity.

stories.h: Haredi rabbis lean toward letting UTJ negotiate with Eisenkot
stories.s: Senior rabbis reportedly favor allowing UTJ into formal coalition talks, with a decision expected Sunday; Kan reported Yashar and UTJ agreed draft-law principles scrapping enlistment quotas while tightening checks on yeshiva students.

stories.h: IDF says week of Gaza strikes killed 10 operatives
stories.s: The military said four of those killed had taken part in the October 7 attack, citing ceasefire violations; overnight Thursday the air force also hit four Hamas weapons depots after warning nearby civilians.

stories.h: IDF strikes Hezbollah rockets at Radwan camp in Lebanon
stories.s: Israel hit dozens of rockets and launchers at an elite Radwan Force training site in the Ain al-Tina area, saying they were meant for attacks on Israelis, while stating it remains committed to the Lebanon ceasefire.

coming.h: Haredi rabbis expected to rule on UTJ coalition talks
coming.s: Final rabbinic approval for UTJ to open formal talks with Yashar is not expected before Sunday; UTJ says it will speed up if Netanyahu makes no rotation announcement by Saturday night.

coming.h: Eisenkot bloc's target date for swearing in government
coming.s: Yashar is aiming to sign all coalition deals, including with UTJ, and swear in a government on Wednesday; his mandate expires December 6 unless Herzog grants an extension.
